cross_account_agree: I am aware of the risks of cross-account migration and confirm that I will continue to operate.
cross_account_migration_desc: If the source device and the target device are not under the same endpoint account, the following changes will be triggered:
cross_account_step_2: 2. Bind the target device to the account {account} of the source device
migrate_danger_notice: Please note that this operation is highly risky, and all data will not be recovered after migration! Please check the SN number carefully!
migrate_proceed_tip: Please read and confirm the following before proceeding:
migrate_sn_summary: System data will be extracted from SN:{fromSn}Transfer to SN:{toSn}
migrate_tip_1: 1. The data migration you are about to perform is an irreversible operation. Once confirmed and submitted, it will take effect immediately.
migrate_tip_2: 2. Irrecoverable risk: If incorrect information is entered or a mistaken operation is performed, the original data will be permanently lost and cannot be recovered. Please ensure all inputs are accurate.
migrate_tip_3: 3. Operation interval restriction: After eachmigration, the system will lock the operation for 5 minutes, during which no further migration can be performed. Do not repeat or execute frequently.
migrate_tip_4: Responsibility Notice: Once confirmed, the system will assume that you understand and accept all risks and consequences
migrate_tip_5: I have read and understood the above and agree to bear all consequences of the operation.
